statement.zh: 宝墩城址群为三星堆「直线前身国家」——属解释性排序，不作定论。
statement.en: That Baodun walled sites are a linear "ancestor state" to Sanxingdui is an interpretive ranking — not a fact verdict.

disclaimer: Hypothesis: linear ancestor-state ranking oversimplifies culture-historical relations.
